source: CEPII BACI V202601, based on UN Comtrade

280530.title: Rare-earth metals, scandium and yttrium
280530.boundary: Includes scandium, yttrium, mixtures and interalloys; not magnet-element-specific.

284690.title: Other rare-earth compounds
284690.boundary: Excludes cerium but includes scandium, yttrium and mixtures; not a separated Nd/Pr/Dy/Tb series.

850511.title: Permanent magnets of metal
850511.boundary: Includes NdFeB, SmCo, AlNiCo and other metallic permanent magnets; not rare-earth-specific.
